title: Add drag-drop file attachment support to ChatAreaComposer
action: Make the composer textarea a drop target for files. Show a visual drop zone overlay when dragging. Display dropped files as removable chip-style attachments below the textarea. Pass files through existing onFileUpload handler.

criteria: Dropping a .png file on the composer shows a chip with filename and remove button
Removed attachment chip clears the file from pending uploads

implementation: 1) Add `isDragging` state. 2) Add onDragOver/onDragEnter/onDragLeave/onDrop handlers to the composer wrapper div. 3) onDragOver: preventDefault, setIsDragging(true). 4) onDragLeave: setIsDragging(false). 5) onDrop: extract files from DataTransfer, store in pendingFiles state, setIsDragging(false). 6) Render pending files as chips (filename + X button) between textarea and toolbar. 7) X button removes from pendingFiles. 8) Send button passes pendingFiles to onFileUpload. 9) Add visual drop overlay (border highlight + 'Drop files here' text) when isDragging is true.
